scope: Native lazy-bank/channel/PC-speaker ownership component. Synthetic immutable clips exercise orchestration; no actor/sector or interactive Play binding.

limits: All 108 valid effect identifiers exercise audible and inaudible requests, separate actor/sector kinds, same-owner replacement, disabled effects, natural completion, stale logical-channel pruning and heap restoration.

Ten exceptional paths cover two constructor allocations, two invalid borrowed owners, two malformed lazy loads, three invalid origin/effect values and deletion while a task owns the object. Malformed-data cleanup is an explicit native recovery contract, not a claim to reproduce original undefined/failing behavior.
Additional cases cover missing and zero-length clips, starting while paused without a tone, pause/resume, deferred silence while the native sound mutex is busy, and deletion during playback.

Port reads/writes are recorded at the deterministic SpeakerHook boundary; native semaphores/mute behavior remain real. Actual PIT task lifecycle is separately rechecked in speaker-evidence.json, and original channel/distance C differentials in audio-evidence.json.
Fixture clips are synthetic and preloaded to isolate ownership. The real Freedoom cache/payload gate remains sound-bank-evidence.json; no asset decoder change is included.
The component is outside Load/Run. Actor generation ownership, moving sector origins, focus loss, interactive render-load scheduling and actual browser audibility remain next integration work.
